name: react-native-example
description: Example React Native app tested and bundled by GitHub Actions on Macrunara M4 runners.

scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev false --bundle-output dist/ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest dist/ios
scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform android --dev false --bundle-output dist/android/index.android.bundle --assets-dest dist/android
